title: AC1015 out-of-version CELLSTYLEMAP raw-only recovery

source.provenance: Existing local corpus file. Its producer and redistribution status are not established by this investigation; it remains outside the repository.

formatBoundary.authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.102
formatBoundary.finding: CELLSTYLEMAP was introduced in AutoCAD 2008. Its occurrence in this AC1015 file is out-of-version, so the newer body must not be interpreted as an AC1015 typed record from this witness alone.

independentPeer.interpretation: Peer typed decoding shows this record exists and is structurally readable to LibreDWG. It does not override the ODA version boundary or qualify an AC1015 body schema.

libdxfrw.change: For the exact AC1015/AC1018 CELLSTYLEMAP and AcDbCellStyleMap class pair, a failed typed parse may fall back only when RawObjectShell validates the common header and handles. The exact source frame is published as raw-only; no typed callback or DXF output eligibility is granted.

after.strictConversion: Still refused before output because skipped unsupported objects make the DWG read disposition incomplete; this is the intended fail-closed result.

test.coverage: Exact AC1015/AC1018 admission plus rejection for AC1014, AC1021, null class, and a mismatched record name.

libdxfrw.fixturePolicy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added.

scopeLimit: The new branch improves tolerant frame recovery only for the exact observed version/class pairs after common-shell validation. It does not add AC1015 CELLSTYLEMAP semantics, serializer support, strict conversion eligibility, producer qualification, or consumer support.
